description: This file implements an authentication service in Python, providing capabilities for user registration, login, JWT token creation and validation, and error handling related to auth processes. It defines the AuthService class and related custom exceptions for managing user authentication workflows within a backend system.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Encapsulates user registration, authentication, JWT creation and decoding, providing the core authentication logic.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base exception class for authentication-related errors.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Raised when user login credentials are invalid.

classes.name: TokenValidationError
classes.description: Raised when a JWT token is invalid or expired.

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password by creating a User record in the database.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns user object along with a JWT token if successful.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a given user ID subject with an expiration time.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token, returning the token payload if valid.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user entity from the database given a user ID.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
